findings.basis: Delegated requirement: missing/source/time transitions never invariance; Stage1 preserves all represented/record/feedback/archived times and Stage3 matches actual source/address/property.
findings.details: Identity contains only origin_chain[0].represented_time. All inherited origin fields use that same outer time, and peak identity omits the remaining origin chain temporal fields. For a fictional copied_prior_record at represented_time=12 whose record_time changes from11 to10 while its peak set stays equal, the peak property is matched and value_unchanged=True. A nested inherited_origin.represented_time change likewise leaves peak identity and other nested leaves matched. The changed temporal leaf itself is recorded changed, but equal leaves and peaks can still be labeled invariant across a time transition.
findings.required_change: Define the temporal coordinates establishing comparability and preserve the full relevant temporal origin chain without substituting represented_time for record/feedback/archive time. Changed temporal operands must be unmatched/unavailable rather than invariance. Add fictional record-time, inherited represented-time and archived-time transition fixtures.
findings.title: Temporal identity omits record, archived, feedback and nested represented times

findings.basis: Delegated requirement: exact source/packet bindings; Stage3 compares actual indexed source-addressed properties.
findings.details: The indexed property path is checked for an equal value; source resolution is separately checked against context. No check proves that packet_path and distribution_packet_path select the node/role named by context. In a fictional packet with equal peak sets at two nodes but different raw distributions, substituting the other node distribution path still passes exact_peak_cells(raw)==unit.value and attaches the wrong raw operand hash. A substituted peak path with equal values likewise passes. The CLI pinned index digest mitigates arbitrary input corruption, but exact binding is not independently verified.
findings.required_change: Resolve the addressed packet node by panel/view/command/node and role and require exact origin/peak/distribution paths and values to be its operands. Reject cross-node, cross-role and cross-panel path substitution even when values coincide.
findings.title: Resolved address is not tied to indexed packet/distribution paths

findings.basis: Stage3 requires construction failures retained as explicit unavailable measurements within the full inventory.
findings.details: validate_index, validate_export and property_table raise on construction failure. No per-template unavailable record or per-pair unavailable state exists. The successful path retains552/684 and failures do not become nulls, but explicit unavailable measurements within the full inventory are not implemented.
findings.required_change: Implement unavailable construction measurements while retaining all684 pairs, or scope this artifact as conditional on fully validated Stage1 and document the unimplemented construction-failure branch.
findings.title: Construction failures abort instead of retaining unavailable measurements
